lines.zh: 扇动着巨大的翅膀，煞针翼缓缓前行。
lines.en: Sweeping its massive wings, Winged moves slowly.

lines.zh: 它的身影如同阴影一般在空中飘动。
lines.en: Its form glides like a shadow in the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍动，发出低沉的呼啸声。
lines.en: Wings beat, producing a low howl.

lines.zh: 在漆黑的洞穴中，煞针翼缓缓移动。
lines.en: In the dark cavern, Winged moves slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀摩擦声，伴随其缓慢的步伐。
lines.en: Wings rubbing, accompanying its slow steps.

lines.zh: 翅膀在黑暗中划过，留下一串回响。
lines.en: Wings slice through the darkness, leaving echoes.

lines.zh: 缓慢飞行，翅膀间歇地扇动。
lines.en: Slow flight, wings beat intermittently.

lines.zh: 阴影般的身躯，在黑夜里无声滑行。
lines.en: Shadowy form glides silently in the night.

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，翅膀偶尔拍动。
lines.en: Moves slowly, wings occasionally beat.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中缓缓前行，翅膀发出细微的声响。
lines.en: Moves slowly in the dark, wings producing subtle sounds.

lines.zh: 收拢翅膀，在岩缝间挪步。
lines.en: Wings folded, I shuffle between the rock seams.

lines.zh: 翼尖扫过石壁，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My wingtips rasp along the stone.

lines.zh: 停在岩壁上，注视着四周。
lines.en: Stops on the rock wall, watching around.

lines.zh: 静静地站在黑暗中，凝视着。
lines.en: Stands silently in the dark, staring.

lines.zh: 静静地伫立，凝视着一切动静。
lines.en: Stands quietly, watching all movements.

lines.zh: 停在洞穴的入口，警惕地观察。
lines.en: Pauses at the cavern entrance, observing vigilantly.

lines.zh: 停在暗处，静静等待猎物。
lines.en: Pauses in the shadows, waiting silently.

lines.zh: 静静站在洞穴深处，观察四周。
lines.en: Stands quietly in the deep cavern, watching around.

lines.zh: 静静地站在那里，翅膀微微颤抖。
lines.en: Stands quietly, wings slightly trembling.
Pauses on the rock, listening carefully.

lines.zh: 在岩壁上静立，警惕地观察。
lines.en: Stands on the rock wall, observing vigilantly.

lines.zh: 静静地站在黑暗中，翅膀轻微振动。
lines.en: Stands silently in the dark, wings slightly vibrating.

lines.zh: 收翅伏在崖边，尾尖轻点。
lines.en: Perched on the cliff, wings folded, tail tapping.

lines.zh: 鳞片映着微光，一动不动。
lines.en: My scales catch the faint light, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 在巢里数着自己的骨刺。
lines.en: In my nest, counting my own bone spurs.
Half a wing shelters the egg beneath me.

lines.zh: 看到玩家，眼中闪过凶光。
lines.en: Player spotted, eyes gleam menacingly.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，翅膀轻微抖动。
lines.en: Locks onto target, wings slightly trembling.
Notices player, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，翅膀微微颤抖。
lines.en: Stares at player, wings slightly trembling.

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，发出警告的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Locks on player, hissing warningly.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，翅膀微微振动。
lines.en: Eyes lock on player, wings slightly vibrating.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Notices player, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，翅膀轻微振动。
lines.en: Stares at player, wings slightly vibrating.

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，眼神中带着杀意。
lines.en: Locks on player, eyes filled with intent to kill.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，发出警告的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Notices player, hissing warningly.

lines.zh: 翼下的眼睛，先看见了你。
lines.en: The eye beneath my wing finds you first.
I lift my head, poison needle tilting forward.

lines.zh: 从崖顶俯看你，翼展渐开。
lines.en: From the cliff top I open my wings and watch.

lines.zh: 你踩响碎石，我盯住了你。
lines.en: You crunch gravel, and my gaze locks on.

lines.zh: 目光顺着岩壁，滑到你身上。
lines.en: My stare slides down the rock face onto you.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰间那卷绳索。
lines.en: I know that rope coil at your belt.
My wings snap shut and my stare pins you.

lines.zh: 你在下面，我在上面看你。
lines.en: You are below; I watch from above.
My wings are hurt, heal me!
I can't fly anymore, help me!
It hurts! It hurts!
Bandage my wounds!
Please heal me!
My wings are wounded!
I'm injured, help me!
My wings were bitten, it hurts!
Give me painkillers!
Fix my wings, they're torn!

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在黑暗中划过，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Its wings scrape against the darkness, creating a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 你被它的光芒吸引，却感到一丝寒意。
lines.en: Its glow attracts you, but you feel a chill.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛像是两颗冰冷的宝石。
lines.en: Its eyes are like two cold gems.

lines.zh: 它的龙肉味道鲜美，但危险重重。
lines.en: Its meat is delicious, but it’s a dangerous catch.

lines.zh: 它的叫声像是遥远的风暴。
lines.en: Its call sounds like a distant storm.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在月光下闪烁。
lines.en: Its scales glimmer in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在阴影中，等待猎物。
lines.en: It lurks in the shadows, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 它的攻击速度快如闪电。
lines.en: Its attack is as fast as lightning.
Its tail whips out and hits you.

lines.zh: 它在夜空中翱翔，留下尾迹。
lines.en: It soars through the night sky, leaving a trail behind.
Your sword pierces its scales.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀撞击发出巨响。
lines.en: Its wings collide, making a loud noise.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌被它的力量震碎。
lines.en: Your shield is shattered by its force.

lines.zh: 它的爪子抓破你的盔甲。
lines.en: Its claws tear through your armor.

lines.zh: 它的身体重重地撞向岩壁。
lines.en: Its body crashes into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你身上撕裂。
lines.en: Its wings tear through your body.
You are sent flying by its power.

lines.zh: 它的头颅撞向地面，尘土飞扬。
lines.en: Its head smashes into the ground, sending up dust.

lines.zh: 它的身体在你之间摩擦。
lines.en: Its body rubs between you.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在你的腿上。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your legs.
They mate in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它们发出低沉的交配声。
lines.en: They make a low mating sound.
Its tentacles gently touch.
They spin around each other.

lines.zh: 它的身体散发出炽热的光芒。
lines.en: Its body emits a fiery glow.

lines.zh: 它们的触须交缠在一起。
lines.en: Their tentacles intertwine.
They move gently in the air.

lines.zh: 它们的眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Their eyes glow with light.
They whisper to each other.
They emit a low sound of affection.
Poison lurks beneath.
Suck its blood.
Its flesh is delicious.
Retreat into the shadows.
Beware, prey detected.
Absorb life force.
Toxic needles pierce.
Devour this body.
Decay gives strength.
Capture it, savor the kill.
Target acquired.
One flap of the wings, and that meat is mine.

lines.zh: 我看见你在崖边缩了一下。
lines.en: I saw you flinch at the cliff edge.
It moves in the distance.
Prey in shadow.
Target moving.
Prey makes noise.
It approaches.
Find next target.
Prey in sight.
That figure on the cliff wall is mine.
You smell of iron. I give chase.

lines.zh: 扇两下翅膀，已到你上方。
lines.en: Two wingbeats put me above you.

lines.zh: 碎石滚落，暴露了你的路。
lines.en: Falling gravel betrayed your path.
This cave mouth only lets things in.

lines.zh: 我要把你从岩缝里拖出来。
lines.en: I will drag you out of that crack.
Target prey.
Prepare attack.
Release toxins.
Its scream.
Attack initiated.
Track and destroy.
It attacks.
Destroy its weakness.
Keep aiming.
My poison needle lines up with your neck.
Don't step back; the cliff is behind you.
My wing's shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 再走一步，就落进我的爪。
lines.en: One more step and you enter my claws.
By the time you look up, the needle lands.
The crevice is too narrow to dodge in.
I circle above your head.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不穿我的翼。
lines.en: Your torch cannot pierce my wings.
The poison needle is an inch away.
Spikes through heart!
Dodge, watch out for the needles!
Toxin injected!
Scales scrape face!
Claws tear!
Run, it's coming!
Needle rain!
Final strike!
Scream tears through the night!

lines.zh: 针刺入肩，翅膀随即压上。
lines.en: The needle sinks into your shoulder, then my wings press down.
One claw flips you over in a spray of gravel.
My wing edge sweeps past and your armor splits.
I bite your arm and drag you toward the drop.
Venom runs down the needle into you.
My tail lashes the back of your knee.
Feel the weight of a dragon's claw.
Creeps in darkness!
Appears in shadows!

lines.zh: 我从崖缝里挤出来，翼还湿。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the cliff crack, wings still damp.
Active at dusk!
Patrols at night!
Holds ambush!
Hides in caves!
Nightmare of the night!
Appears in Corruption!
Chases prey without rest!
In the cliff nest, wings begin to beat.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，毒针先探出来。
lines.en: The shell cracks and the poison needle comes first.

lines.zh: 从云后的岩壁俯冲下来。
lines.en: I dive from the cliff behind the clouds.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，一对翅膀展开。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, a pair of wings unfolds.

lines.zh: 风把龙腥味吹到你脚边。
lines.en: The wind carries dragon musk to your feet.

lines.zh: 我落在断崖最高那块石上。
lines.en: I land on the highest stone of the broken cliff.
A shadow passes. That is me, flying.
A long cry rolls through the valley.
Flames burned through my wing membrane.
Hold me back, I didn't fall!
My wings won't spread underwater; I sink.
The explosion hurt me, heal me!
An arrow is wedged between my wing bones.
Magic hurt me, heal me!
Too hungry to beat my wings.
Lightning hurt me, help me!
In the void my wings find no air.
